name: Music Broadcast Limited

annual_report.business: Music Broadcast Limited operates Radio City, India's leading private FM radio network with 39 stations across 12 states, offering integrated audio advertising solutions across on-air, digital, on-ground, and experiential platforms.

segments.name: Digital Channels (social media, website, influencers, third-party tie-ups)
International and National IPs, Big-ticket Campaigns, CI, Local and Regional Initiatives, Festive Campaigns

guidance_or_targets.statement: Radio industry revenues expected to remain largely flat in the near term and potentially decline to Rs 2,200 crore by 2028 if structural challenges persist.

key_risks: Structural decline in radio advertising revenue due to shift to digital audio platforms and streaming
Lower ad yields (down 9%) and transition of inventory from high-yield metro markets to smaller towns
Shutdown of private FM stations due to financial unviability
High license fees and fixed cost structure impacting profitability
Impairment losses on non-financial and financial assets
Dependence on advertising revenue with cyclical and seasonal fluctuations

note: Verdict v3 is a prototype; peer-relative; not investment advice
